main_body: Wooden dresser with a top surface carrying small items (bottles, books, red box), and a front face with four recessed drawers.
top_band: Mid-orange band at rows 6-11 (the top surface with items on it), then a lighter front-edge line at row 12
evidence: In a central column, rows 6-11 are a wide orange top with objects standing on it. Row 12 is a lighter front-edge line, and rows 13-14 are dark brown eave shadow. From row 15 down is the front face, with drawers set in by dark dividers and shadow edges, ending at a dark plinth around rows 29-31. This matches the green cabinet in the guide: a top band, an edge and an eave over a front face.

style.evidence: The outline is a dark brown that leans toward the wood, which is fine. The wood has only about 4 steps (light top edge, orange mid, tan drawer frame, dark brown). The top surface and the drawer interiors are large areas of one flat colour with no grain or speckle. The reference dresser has more wood grain, handle detail and variation per tile. Most tiles here carry only 3-5 colours, so the piece reads thinner and flatter than the reference.
